description: This file defines a class 'FeaturePropertyModifiedStrategy' which handles 'FeaturePropertyModified' events by applying property modifications to a 'ThingBuilder'. It is part of an event-handling strategy within a persistence layer for 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractThingEventStrategy to handle FeaturePropertyModified events.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the base method to apply a FeaturePropertyModified event to a ThingBuilder, setting the specified property.
